Define
\[
A_n=\sum_{k=1}^n(2k-1)2^k.
\]
Let
\[
S_n=\sum_{k=1}^nk2^k.
\]
Multiplying by 2 and subtracting gives
\[
2S_n-S_n=\sum_{k=1}^n k2^k-\sum_{k=1}^n(k-1)2^k
=n2^n-\sum_{k=1}^{n-1}2^k=n2^n-(2^n-2),
\]
so
\[
S_n=(n-1)2^{n+1}+2.
\]
Hence
\[
A_n=2S_n-(2^{n+1}-2)
=(2n-3)2^{n+1}+6.
\]
Setting $n=2024$ yields
\[
\boxed{A_{2024}=4045\cdot2^{2025}+6}.
\]
